summary: This component displays Bluesky engagement stats for a post, showing like and repost counts plus a stack of avatars from people who engaged with it. It limits the display to 10 avatars and shows a '+N' indicator if more people engaged than can fit, with each avatar linking to that person's profile and labeled with what actions they took (liked, reposted, commented).

explanations.11: This function takes a Set of engagement actions and converts them into a human-readable sentence fragment — like 'liked and reposted' or 'liked, reposted, and commented on'.
explanations.18: This builds a grammatically correct list: if there are multiple verbs, it joins all but the last with commas, then adds 'and' before the final verb.
explanations.26: We return nothing (null) if data is still loading or if we don't have engagement data yet, so the component renders invisibly.
explanations.30: We grab only the first MAX_AVATARS (10) people from the full list so we don't render too many avatars on screen.
explanations.31: This calculates how many people engaged beyond the 10 we're showing, so we can display a '+5' or '+12' badge later.
explanations.47: Only render the avatars section if at least one person is in our 'shown' list; if nobody engaged, skip the whole avatar stack.
explanations.56: The zIndex makes avatars stack visually in order — earlier avatars appear on top — by giving higher z-index values to people earlier in the list.
explanations.57: The title attribute creates a tooltip that reads like 'Jane Doe (@janedoe) liked and reposted this post' when you hover over the avatar.
